Make · Learn · Discover.

Who we are

Kiddo.school is an independent digital school for curious children and the adults learning alongside them. The journey begins at birth with short, parent-led baby and toddler classes and grows into hands-on classrooms in art, science, nature, maths, stories and engineering. Forty classes from birth to age five are ready today, with more on the drawing table.

Why we started

Young children learn best by touching, drawing, counting and talking with someone they love, yet most online learning pulls them toward a screen and leaves parents guessing what to do next. We started Kiddo.school to put the grown-up back in the teacher’s seat: clear steps, printable pages and short classes that fit into a real day, so a few playful minutes together can be enough.

What you will find here

Age-guided classes, printable worksheets, flashcards, coloring pages and drawing lessons, each with parent guidance and simple adaptations. A crooked collage, a bridge that bends or a seed that has not sprouted can all begin a useful conversation. The aim is to notice, try, question and make something your own.

From the Principal’s Office

Welcome to Kiddo.school. This school is a little different: you are the teacher, and we are the helper. Two promises from the school office: age ranges here are guides, never tests or developmental deadlines, and nothing on Kiddo School is a score. Children learn at their own pace, and noticing one red thing together already counts as a class.
